levels.surface: جعفر بن محمد بن إبراهيم الموسوي
جعفر بن محمد بن حكيم الخثعمي

notes: Three routes to one saying (مثله). Route 1 is the first hadith (حدثني ... عن أبي الحسن). Route 2 has جميعا: Ibn Abi Umayr and Ibrahim b. Abd al-Hamid are co-transmitters (rule 2). Route 3 is the father's chain.
سألته in route 1 is the same man as أبي الحسن written again (rule 7), so he is one link.
Route 3 writes أبي ره: relation, with the blessing removed.
